title: too strong
text: too strong. when I read the reviews on this mixer,I had some doubts because a lot of them said this was a very strong mixer and some adjusted the way they used it and it worked better for them..... well I tried all types of coffee cups and each one was still too short because the coffee still poured over the sides,even in the very tall mugs. I tried filling it only 1/2 and still had problems. this item is not good for my cups.I am not going to spend time watching to make sure about the amount of coffee in the cup or,cleaning up the mess etc. I will try to use this for maybe some cold drinks or so..too much coffee mess
